title: Symmetric step sets that make a harmony
claim: Proved, refereed by fresh code and an independent session: odd not-all-equal harmonies of periods 73 and 193 exist, unsplit (steps {1, 2}·H at 73 and {1, 2, 4+3i}·H at 193, H the fourth roots of 1; 730 and 386 compatible words, no two differing in one place), by lemma 4 of EVEN-PERIOD-20261112-001, which holds at every odd n. Exact, within the two frozen families (unions of one to three cosets of a subgroup containing -1; the doubled steps {±1,±2,±t(,±2t)}): harmonies at 61, 73 and 193 only, for every odd n from 33 to 59 and every prime from 61 to 199, one set each up to a multiplier, each with stabiliser exactly the fourth roots of 1.
failure_conditions: Two compatible words of a reported harmony differing in one place.
A state of a reported base on a long window breaking its n-repeat.
A set of the frozen families making a harmony that the scan missed, or one it reported failing to.
foundation_claim_scope: The plain not-all-equal law on bases along one shift; step sets of two frozen families at every odd n from 33 to 59 and every prime from 61 to 199; counts of H u 2H at the primes 1 mod 4 from 41 to 199.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead on 2026-11-12, pre-registered (commit 3cec8a886); refereed by fresh code (fam_referee.py) and by an independent fresh model session (independent_referee/report.md).
validation.status: lemma by hand; exhaustive scan of the frozen families (check.py); both referees passed
